preOutcomeStatement: Written before the edit-analysis author inspected E outcomes; formulas follow the earlier frozen evaluation protocol and parent-approved clarification.
canonicalTrial: first terminal record; later accidental attempts never promote results

estimands.cold: same guarded policy before and after edit
estimands.warm: same current-source drawing, same prior sides, manual/pin/scope constraints for all candidate actions

guard.trigger: raw candidate hard-invalid or failed/timed_out, and current edited source output hard-valid
guard.warmGuard: not evaluated unless matching warm constraint certification is explicitly supplied
guard.metricsReference: Recompute fallback movement against the candidate policy pre-edit reference.
guard.runtime: sum raw operation cost plus measured current-source fallback operation cost; label derived serial estimate, not a measured guard UI interaction

stableScore: balanced DI per10 + translationAdjustedMean/24 +5*changedSideRate; requires available movement/history and valid result
requestedGlobalReflow: stable score =balanced DI per10; omit BOTH displacement and side-churn penalties but retain every raw component
negativeControl: color_control kept separate from ordinary edit aggregates; exact geometry,1px comparator, node-only and route/path changes reported; missing reference route history stays unavailable

bootstrap.unit: base diagram; retain its complete five-edit bundle
bootstrap.interval: 2.5th and97.5th percentile of paired base means

denominators: Failures stay in hard validity and runtime denominators. Soft/movement paired comparisons show available and jointly-valid counts. No pooling warm and cold references.
heldoutGuard: Default development-only. Heldout requires explicit --split heldout --allow-heldout-after-freeze and existing data/policy-freeze.json.
